title: Greenlights
author: Matthew McConaughey
summary: Matthew McConaughey draws on decades of diaries to tell stories from his Texas childhood, his path to acting and fatherhood, and the lessons he took from them, in a loose, rambling and quotable voice.
readIf: you like celebrity memoirs with a folksy voice and a lot of life philosophy.
skipIf: you want a tidy chronological career account or a skeptical tone.
